_comment: Bounded UA worldwide municipal-cooperation harvest. One pending item per agent tick. Candidates go to data/research-log/intl-harvest/ — not the release, not known=true. Skip Wikipedia twin lists, C4C profile HTML, Kyiv city, raion RDA→city, Ministry Tableau export. Best compiled public directory so far: U-LEAD/GIZ URC map (June 2026).

items.title: Cities4Cities WP news (pair hypotheses from titles, not seeking bios)
items.note: Already cached under data/cache/twinning/cities4cities-news.json. Refresh if stale; extract UA–foreign names from titles only.

items.title: KL Denmark — municipal Ukraine partnerships beyond Aalborg/Aarhus/Ikast-Brande
items.note: Skip Copenhagen/Odense–Kyiv. Do not invent pairs from programme blurbs without two named municipalities. Listed URL 404; recovered via KL Jan 2024 twinning list + venskabsbyer seeking page.

items.title: SKR/SALAR International — Swedish municipal Ukraine partnerships not on Skruv
items.note: Skruv 33 kommuner already curated in twinning-nordic-pairs.json (2026-08-14). Harvest only deltas. SKR Ukraine hub/PDF is programme copy (Polaris/WM4U/C4C), not an extra pair roster. «30 kommuner» on SKR is not a named list.

items.title: VNG International NL–UA municipal partnerships
items.note: Named gemeente ↔ hromada only. Programme pages without a UA place are not pairs. SDLG Ukraine names 15 unnamed municipalities + a Kyiv conference; no twinning roster. Vysokopillia MVA quoted without a Dutch gemeente.

items.title: Union of the Baltic Cities — UA members / twins
items.note: Membership ≠ twinning. Record named sister-city claims only. Homepage lists UA members (Kolomyia, Kamianets-Podilskyi, associated Vilnyansk/Pokrovsk/Zaporizhzhia) plus Rivne oblast (skipped) and a frontline-cities association. City cards and the refugee-help page have no sister-city roster.

items.title: EU-27 holes: Ireland, Luxembourg, Malta municipal news
items.note: Search municipal sites / C4C news for IE/LU/MT. Empty result is a valid done. C4C WP search Ireland/Irish/Luxembourg/Malta = 0 posts; twinning-partners and partnership-map also 0 rows for IE/LU/MT.

items.title: KS Norway — kommune partnerships beyond Lier–Pavlohrad
items.note: Homepage had no Ukraine links; recovered via KS search → official roster «Norske samarbeidspartnere i Ukraina» (edited 2025-12-04; table includes Suldal 2026-02-04). 16 table rows. Skip Oslo–Kyiv and Akershus fylke–Poltava. Time is a 3-name UA cluster (Vysoke katottg left null). Lier–Pavlohrad, Karmøy–Korosten, AUC Bergen–Lviv and Hamar–Rivne are not on this KS roster — do not invent them here. Kristiansand–Mykolaiv is the southern city.

items.title: Kuntaliitto / Finnish municipal Ukraine twins beyond Imatra–Nizhyn
items.note: Official roster https://www.kuntaliitto.fi/aihealue/ukraina (19 FI–UA ystävyyskunta rows). Turku–Kharkiv was not in partnership-map, so harvested. Skip Helsinki/Tampere–Kyiv. Dedup Imatra/Lahti/Lappeenranta/Loviisa/Oulu already in twinning-partners. Kotka–Mykolajiv left katottg null (homonym). Kajaani–Uzhhorod and Suomussalmi–Zviahel are in our layers but not on this Kuntaliitto page — not invented here.

items.title: UK LGA / council friendship agreements beyond BANES–Oleksandriia
items.note: Homepage has no Ukraine links. /our-support/international is CEMR/Congress membership, not a UK–UA pair roster (0 Ukraine mentions). Site search is POST and did not return hits from the query-string URL. /topics/communities/ukrainian-refugees 404. Direct HTTP 403 without a browser. Empty result is valid: LGA does not publish a named council↔hromada directory. BANES–Oleksandriia stays in nordic-pairs from Bath Echo, not from this LGA pass. Do not invent Liverpool/Sheffield/etc. from our twinning layer onto this source.

items.title: Remaining SKEW unmatched UA spellings → aliases
items.note: Offline: 88 unmatched rows (60 unmatched / 19 rajon / 5 non_hromada / 4 kyiv_city). 60 unmatched processed into JSONL. 43 unique cheap alias keys with KATOTTG (use _katottg — Trostjanez/Trostjanets and Schyroke collide on name). Skip Crimea (Jalta/Yevpatoriia/Simferopol), 5 already in twinning-name-aliases.json pending rebuild, Semenivka-Odesa homonym, Tairov missing Katottg, Chornomorsk city missing from hromadas.json, 4 villages without a hromada. Did not write aliases into the release file this tick.

items.title: U-LEAD/GIZ URC map — 2810 worldwide municipal partnerships (June 2026)
items.note: Best public compiled directory found. GeoJSON carddata 592 hromadas. Skip Kyiv city (72 partners). Not a Ministry Tableau scrape. Latin partner spellings rarely collide with Ukrainian twinning names so overlap looks small (153). Do not fold into releases this tick.

items.title: Alliance of US-Ukraine City Partnerships — linked-cities roster
items.note: SCI-derived roster on AUUCP (page cites 22 US cities; 15 named pair headings). Skip Chicago–Kyiv and Santa Cruz–Alushta (Crimea). Six already in twinning under Ukrainian partner spellings. Horlivka/Krasnodon rows have null Katottg in hromadas.json. Did not follow per-city Read More pages.

items.title: Sister Cities International membership directory — Ukraine partners
items.note: Listed URL 403 via urllib; recovered the same directory from an earlier successful fetch of that URL (27 US city → Ukraine lines). Skip Chicago–Kyiv and Highlands–Hodinovka (village, no hromada). Membership ≠ always a signed pair; confidence stays directory. Did not follow per-city pages. AUUCP overlap tagged already_in_auucp; Ministry twinning overlap tagged already_in_twinning. Several of the 10 new-vs-twinning rows also sit on the GIZ URC map — independent SCI confirmation, not folded into releases.

items.title: FCM Canada — municipal Ukraine partnerships beyond Langford cluster
items.note: Homepage is a hub with no Ukraine links. /en/programs/international 404. International focus + current International Programs list Tunisia/Viet Nam/Africa-Asia gender programmes — no live Ukraine roster. Closed PLEDDG (2015–2021) names 16 unnamed UA cities; older MLED news names 12 unnamed cities in Lviv and Dnipropetrovsk oblasts. 2022 solidarity statement names no municipality. Empty result is valid: FCM does not publish a named CA↔hromada directory. Langford–Volyn cluster stays in twinning from Ministry/GIZ, not from this FCM pass. Do not invent Winnipeg/Toronto/Vancouver from our layers onto this source.

items.title: Association of Ukrainian Cities — international partnership news
items.note: Homepage hub had no pair roster; /novyny 404. Claimed AUC twinning database (140 cities / 727 twins) is not a public URL. Bridges of Trust «36 partnerships» unnamed. Harvested three in-domain news pages (KS/AUC Norway track). Official agreements: Lviv–Bergen, Pavlohrad–Lier (already nordic), Rivne–Hamar, Mykolaiv–Kristiansand (already KS, southern city), Zaporizhzhia OVA–Trøndelag (skipped). Keep Rivne–Hamar distinct from Rivne–Fredrikstad. Horodok is Lviv oblast, not Khmelnytskyi. Did not invent C4C/Wikipedia pairs or mix oblast with city.
